generations.prompt: Photoreal, afternoon in a small laundromat, 35 mm. The silver-haired woman in the mustard-yellow raincoat draws in the sketchbook on her knee while the washing machines turn behind her; she glances at the two people folding at the table and back to the page. The young man and the middle-aged woman at the folding table fold a sheet between them, stepping together and apart, talking to each other in a quiet, natural, continuous conversation. Sound: their conversation, clearly audible, with the tumble and hum of the machines and the snap of a sheet; no music. The camera is locked off and does not move. She does not speak. Exactly the people already in the frame; nobody new enters. No on-screen text, no captions, no lettering anywhere.
